repository_state.reason: Lot 5.1 DB and TypeScript contract foundations are implemented without real provider networking. Node validation is green; the isolated PostgreSQL recipe must be run by the maintainer before 5.2 can be authorized.

working_lot.name: Providers and API synchronization core
scope: Providers administration and provider detail pages
Provider adapters and adapter-specific configuration forms
Encrypted provider secrets with key_version
Automatic championship discovery with manual activation
Manual championship configuration when discovery is unavailable
Per-championship adapter-specific source configuration supporting different endpoints and strategies within the same provider; WRC is a known OCBlackTop example
Current-year-first bootstrap
Historical backfill across all available seasons
Continuous current-year rescan from January 1 to end then restart
Round-robin scheduling across active championships
Persistent provider-specific synchronization cursors
Persistent scheduler leases and crash recovery
Automatic cadence calculation from short-term and monthly quotas
Thirty-percent monthly quota reserve for current-year synchronization by default
Retry with exponential backoff and jitter for transient failures
Provider suspension for durable auth/configuration failures
Normalization, mappings, idempotence and deduplication
Preservation of local corrections
Missing-provider-event signaling without automatic deletion
Public API suppression when a championship is disabled without deleting data
Structured synchronization history and rotating technical logs
Local championship logo upload
mandatory_constraints: Newly discovered championships are never synchronized automatically before manual activation
One provider is principal for a championship in V1
No synchronization starts automatically when safe quota limits are unknown
Provider secrets are never returned after storage and never logged
Local corrections always remain effective over provider values
No automatic deletion of provider events that disappear
Disabled championships remain in the database and administration but are excluded from the public API
Decorative values present in generated mockups do not override the approved concept document
